source: Authenticated App Store Connect UI, independent server readback, successful CI and actual signed IPA inspection

previousRejection.issue: The onboarding permission pre-alert used custom Allow buttons and a Finish and begin action that bypassed the system request.

packagedSourceVerification.comparison: Every listed packaged file matched the approved source exactly after normalizing only Git Windows CRLF to macOS LF line endings. No other differences were accepted.

reviewNotes.text:
Build 54 replaces build 53 and addresses guideline 5.1.1(iv). The entire onboarding permission screen was removed, including its custom Allow buttons and Finish and begin action.

Fresh install: choose Hebrew or English, Continue, review the legal documents and provide the four separate confirmations, choose profile wording and Continue. Name, exact age and body measurements are optional. Setup enters the working app without microphone, speech, HealthKit, notification or Face ID permission requests. Voice commands and biometric locking start off on new installations.

Manual workout planning, recording, exercise instructions and history need no account, payment or permission grant. Access is requested only when choosing the relevant voice/Health feature or its settings action. Settings request buttons use neutral Continue wording and call the native system request; there is no dismissible onboarding pre-alert. Refusing microphone access leaves manual entry available; refusing Health access leaves records saved locally. A system Settings link and status information are available in Settings.

Existing saved choices, plans, history and active workouts are preserved. Published Hebrew/English terms and privacy documents remain in place. No demo credentials or activation code are required. Optional speech commands currently support Hebrew. Public release remains manual.

boundaries: Owner explicitly approved build54 upload and resubmission after checks. Free pricing, manual release, existing data, privacy declarations and content-rights attestation were retained. No public release or developer-agreement acceptance was performed. Historical build52 and build53 receipts remain unchanged. Review acceptance is not guaranteed.
